decisions.thought: Opponent has sand offense potential (Tyranitar + Garchomp + Dragapult) plus Gengar, Rotom-Wash, Clefable. My Gholdengo (scarf) outspeeds and hits Ttar/Gengar/Clefable/Dragapult hard. Mega Garchomp beats Ttar, Gengar, Rotom. Dragapult outspeeds their whole team and U-turns for momentum. Clefable is the main wall — Gholdengo's Make It Rain and Dragapult's U-turn pressure it. Avoid leading Garchomp into a possible Ice Fang/Fire Fang Chomp lead; scarf Gholdengo lead is safe into everything except Ttar, which it still chunk
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo scarf, Garchomp mega, Dragapult look good. Slowking-Galar also decent vs Clefable/Rotom. Opponent has Tyranitar sand + Ttar weak to fighting. Gholdengo covers Clefable, Ttar, Dragapult, Gengar. Garchomp beats Ttar/Gengar/Rotom. Dragapult handles... let's bring gholdengo, garchomp, dragapult.

decisions.thought: Plan: Bring Dragapult, Gengar, and Rotom‑Wash. Dragapult for fast sweeping, Gengar for Nasty Plot vs Garchomp/Dragapult, Rotom‑Wash for Volt Switch support and to keep the field safe from Water/Electric threats. Expect opponent to use Dragapult, Garchomp, and a Steel/ghost (Gholdengo/Corviknight). Gengar will set up against Garchomp, Dragapult will finish off weakened foes, and Rotom‑Wash will keep momentum.
